mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings slip onto the cap and block side groove too easily rather than being an interference fit, risking a spun thrust main, and says King technical support told him the 2024 production is out of spec. Strongest live complaint on file.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
